title: position:absolute+inset:0 escapes to viewport when reparented into a position:static container
trigger: A position:absolute+inset:0 overlay is reparented (appendChild) into a new container on cleanup/transition, and the new container is position:static — the overlay escapes to the initial containing block (viewport) instead of filling the container
principle: position:absolute is constrained by the nearest positioned ancestor (position !== static), NOT by the direct parent. When reparenting an absolute-positioned overlay, the new parent MUST be position:relative (or positioned). If the parent is position:static, inset:0 resolves against the initial containing block (viewport/document) — the overlay covers the whole page instead of the intended container. Always save the overlay's original parent before moving it and restore that exact parent on cleanup, OR set position:relative on the new parent before the move. Never assume the cleanup target has the same CSS positioning as the original mount point.

cases.context: Split View cleanup moves #cell-subtitle-root (position:absolute, inset:0) back into playerShell. On themoviebox, playerShell = .w-full h-[203px] (position:static), while the original mount parent was .art-video-player (position:relative). The overlay escapes to 1891×986 at (0,0) covering the whole page instead of the 1226×690 video.

Two container-finding algorithms return different elements: findVideoContainer (first ancestor with height >= video*0.5, used for initial overlay mount) returns .art-video-player (position:relative), while findPlayerContainer (farthest same-size ancestor, used for Split View playerShell) returns .w-full h-[203px] (position:static). Split View cleanup used playerShell as the restore target, assuming it matches the original mount parent — it doesn't.
cases.bad:
// assume playerShell == overlay's original parent
playerShell.appendChild(cellRootCleanup); // wrong: playerShell != findVideoContainer result

applyFor: Reparenting position:absolute overlays on Split View / Player Mode / fullscreen cleanup
Any DOM move where the source and target parents may have different CSS position values
Overlay containers that use inset:0 to fill a parent — verify the parent is positioned before reparenting
Cleanup/restore logic that assumes the restore target matches the original mount point
